problems: Two dossiers repaired (east-india-company, kingdom-of-sikkim); both validate with 0 errors and 0 warnings under --resolve. Scripts and copies are in /tmp/claude-0/work/sa-06-x-fix/.

Applied east-india-company: Andaman (gain 1789 Port Blair, move 1791 to Port Cornwallis, loss May 1796, regained Nov 1857; Nicobars removed), Thanjavur (gain 1799, one-cell fort tint 1799-1855, fort gained 1855), Punjab 1849 (five frontier districts as circles without the tribal areas instead of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa), Tehri Garhwal subtracted from the 1816 gain (confidence 2) with a vassal tint (counterpart garhwal-kingdom), Surat note, Nagpur 1853. Thin items: Assam without Cachar (Cachar plains 1832, hills 1834, Jaintia 15 March 1835, Upper Assam to Purandar Singha April 1833 to September 1838), Calcutta 1696 (Fort William page), Dindigul 1792, Ajmer 25 June 1818, Merwara May 1823.

Applied kingdom-of-sikkim: outlying lands redefined as {minus: [circle, Sikkim admin-1 ...]}; keyframes now 84, 81, 28, 48, 47 and 27 cells (the 1861-1975 rump equals the dissolve region, ratio 1.05 to the page's 6,500 km2); Darjeeling disc cut from 30 km to 10 km because the Darjeeling district page gives 138 square miles; Kalimpong added to the bridge and lost to kingdom-of-bhutan in 1706 (confidence 2); bridge raised to confidence 2 on the History page's 'annexed ... the present-day Darjeeling district, and parts of today's eastern Nepal'.

Disagreements with the reviewer, all explained in the notes: the Darjeeling disc size; the Thanjavur fort is gained in 1855 rather than left as a note; the Tehri circles are the garhwal-kingdom dossier's own (they cross the Alaknanda at Srinagar) so no cell is claimed twice; item 8a (Bahawalpur mirror) not applied.
For the owner of kingdom-of-bhutan: its Kalimpong events use the counterpart string 'sikkim', not the slug kingdom-of-sikkim, and the place name Kalimpong is not in the gazetteer.

For the owner of kingdom-of-nagpur / jhansi-state: east-india-company now annexes Nagpur in 1853 (meets kingdom-of-nagpur's end) and Jhansi in 1854 (jhansi-state opens its contest with british-empire in 1853).

For the owner of ahom-kingdom: the dossier ends in 1826 and mentions Purandar Singha (1833-1838) only as an infobox ruler; east-india-company now records the 1833 handover and 1838 annexation with the counterpart string 'Purandar Singha (Upper Assam; no dossier)'.

Page extracts come from WebFetch (a small model's reading), not whole pages; a few extracts were inconsistent (Archibald Blair says 1792 move and 1795 closure against May 1796 on Andaman Islands; Dimasa Kingdom gives 1832, 1833 and 1834 in different sentences) and the notes say which value is used.
